quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a foundation model fine-tuning platform enabling enterprises to build proprietary AI on private data.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform fine-tunes leading AI models on your proprietary data within a secure private environment - frontier AI performance with the data confidentiality your business requires.
quests.hint: Lead with the private data confidentiality assurance.
quests.explanation: Data confidentiality is the primary enterprise barrier to generative AI adoption - solving it unlocks the market.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI hallucination detection layer making enterprise LLM deployments reliable.
quests.correctAnswer: Our system intercepts LLM outputs and validates factual accuracy before any response reaches users - making enterprise AI reliable enough for high-stakes business decisions.
quests.hint: Lead with the high-stakes reliability.
quests.explanation: Reliability for high-stakes decisions separates enterprise AI deployment from experimental use.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a multimodal AI platform processing documents images audio and code in unified workflows.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform processes any combination of documents images audio and code in a single unified workflow - AI productivity across every content type that enterprise teams handle.
quests.hint: Lead with the unified cross-content workflow.
quests.explanation: Unified cross-modal processing removes the siloed AI tool problem that prevents enterprise-wide productivity.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a level four autonomous vehicle fleet management platform for urban freight.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform orchestrates level four autonomous vehicles for urban freight delivery - operating around the clock with no driver costs and no fatigue risk of any kind.
quests.hint: Lead with the no driver no fatigue dual advantage.
quests.explanation: No driver cost plus no fatigue risk addresses both the economic and safety cases simultaneously.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an autonomous drone inspection platform for infrastructure maintenance.
quests.correctAnswer: Our drones inspect bridges pipelines and power lines autonomously and generate detailed structural reports - replacing dangerous manual inspections with a faster and safer automated alternative.
quests.hint: Lead with the safety replacement of dangerous manual work.
quests.explanation: Replacing specifically dangerous manual work with autonomous inspection is a safety and liability case.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an autonomous agricultural vehicle platform for year-round precision farming.
quests.correctAnswer: Our autonomous farm vehicles operate around the clock in every season - planting spraying and harvesting with centimetre-level precision that no human operator can consistently maintain.
quests.hint: Lead with the centimetre precision that humans cannot maintain.
quests.explanation: Centimetre-level consistency that humans cannot achieve is the performance superiority claim that makes autonomous farming compelling.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a cell-free protein synthesis platform accelerating biologic drug manufacturing.
quests.correctAnswer: Our cell-free synthesis produces biologic medicines outside living cells - reducing manufacturing time from weeks to days and enabling on-demand production of critical therapies.
quests.hint: Lead with the weeks to days production speed.
quests.explanation: Weeks to days in biologic manufacturing unlocks on-demand production that could transform global medicine supply.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a programmable matter platform using DNA nanotechnology for targeted drug delivery.
quests.correctAnswer: Our DNA nanotechnology constructs drug delivery vehicles that navigate to specific cells release their payload and self-assemble safely - precision medicine at the molecular level.
quests.hint: Lead with the molecular precision navigation.
quests.explanation: Molecular precision in drug delivery is the frontier of targeted oncology - connecting to it creates an exciting pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a living bioink platform for 3D bioprinting functional human tissue.
quests.correctAnswer: Our bioink incorporates living cells into 3D-printable structures that mature into functional tissue - enabling organ-on-chip drug testing and eventually transplantable grafts.
quests.hint: Lead with the functional maturation into tissue.
quests.explanation: Functional tissue maturation from printed structures is the scientific milestone that makes bioprinting a medical breakthrough.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a neuromorphic chip manufacturer delivering AI inference at biological energy efficiency.
quests.correctAnswer: Our neuromorphic chips run AI inference at the energy efficiency of biological neural circuits - enabling always-on edge AI in battery-constrained devices without ever reaching a charger.
quests.hint: Lead with the always-on without charging benefit.
quests.explanation: Always-on AI without charging removes the battery barrier preventing AI-at-the-edge in wearables and sensors.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a photonic computing startup delivering light-speed AI training.
quests.correctAnswer: Our photonic processors run AI training at the speed of light consuming a fraction of the electricity of conventional GPU clusters - faster cheaper and dramatically cooler.
quests.hint: Lead with the speed-of-light computation.
quests.explanation: Light-speed computation is a genuinely striking physical claim that makes the product technically extraordinary.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an in-memory computing architecture eliminating data transfer bottlenecks in AI workloads.
quests.correctAnswer: Our in-memory computing architecture processes AI workloads where the data lives - eliminating the transfer bottleneck that constrains every conventional AI accelerator on the market.
quests.hint: Lead with the bottleneck elimination.
quests.explanation: Data transfer bottleneck elimination is the fundamental architectural advance that in-memory computing provides.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a dexterous manipulation robot enabling assembly in unstructured environments.
quests.correctAnswer: Our robot hands have the dexterity to assemble components in unstructured environments - adapting to variation in ways that conventional rigid industrial automation cannot handle.
quests.hint: Lead with the unstructured environment capability.
quests.explanation: Unstructured environment capability is the frontier that rigid industrial automation has never solved.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a human-robot collaboration platform enabling safe shared workspaces.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform enables humans and robots to share the same workspace safely - the robot dynamically adjusts based on human position and intent rather than stopping when anyone enters.
quests.hint: Lead with the dynamic adjustment rather than stop.
quests.explanation: Dynamic co-existence rather than safety-stop is what makes human-robot collaboration truly productive.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a soft robotics platform for delicate agricultural harvesting tasks.
quests.correctAnswer: Our soft robotic grippers handle delicate fruits and vegetables without bruising - bringing robotic harvesting to crops that rigid automation damages and human pickers currently dominate.
quests.hint: Lead with the crops rigid automation damages.
quests.explanation: Naming the specific limitation of rigid automation for delicate crops creates immediate credibility.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart city operating system integrating transport energy and public safety data.
quests.correctAnswer: Our smart city OS integrates real-time data from transport energy and public safety into a single command centre - complete situational awareness for city operators who currently make decisions blind.
quests.hint: Lead with the complete situational awareness.
quests.explanation: Complete situational awareness across city systems is the command capability that city leaders currently lack.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an urban mobility platform combining autonomous vehicles public transit and cycling.
quests.correctAnswer: Our mobility platform combines autonomous vehicles public transit and cycling into one optimised journey - the most efficient route across every mode with one payment and one app.
quests.hint: Lead with the single optimised journey.
quests.explanation: Single optimised journey across all modes is the MaaS ideal that no single transport operator can provide.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital twin platform for national critical infrastructure resilience planning.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform creates a complete digital twin of critical national infrastructure - simulating cyberattacks natural disasters and cascading failures so governments can plan before crises occur.
quests.hint: Lead with the pre-crisis simulation.
quests.explanation: Pre-crisis scenario simulation converts reactive emergency management into strategic resilience.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a product lifecycle digital twin reducing time to market and warranty failures.
quests.correctAnswer: Our digital twin tracks every product from design through manufacture use and end of life - identifying design flaws in simulation before warranty failures occur in the real world.
quests.hint: Lead with the pre-warranty design flaw identification.
quests.explanation: Identifying design flaws before warranty failures converts expensive field corrections into cheap simulation improvements.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a human performance digital twin for elite sport and military training.
quests.correctAnswer: Our human performance digital twin models physiological and cognitive response to training load - enabling precision performance optimisation without trial and error on the athlete's actual body.
quests.hint: Lead with the no trial-and-error on the actual body.
quests.explanation: Modelling before testing on the body is a persuasive safety and performance case in high-stakes environments.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an edge AI inference platform delivering real-time decisions on IoT devices without cloud.
quests.correctAnswer: Our edge AI platform runs inference directly on IoT hardware - delivering real-time decisions in milliseconds without cloud connectivity in environments where connectivity cannot be guaranteed.
quests.hint: Lead with the no-connectivity requirement.
quests.explanation: No-connectivity inference removes the biggest deployment blocker for AI in remote industrial and medical environments.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a federated learning platform training AI models without centralising private data.
quests.correctAnswer: Our federated platform trains AI models across distributed devices without any data ever leaving the device - AI at scale with complete user privacy guaranteed.
quests.hint: Lead with the data never leaving the device.
quests.explanation: Data never leaving the device is the privacy commitment that makes federated learning compelling for regulated industries.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a 5G private network deployment platform for industrial campuses.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform deploys dedicated 5G networks on industrial campuses - delivering the ultra-low latency and guaranteed bandwidth that mission-critical manufacturing automation requires.
quests.hint: Lead with the guaranteed bandwidth for mission-critical.
quests.explanation: Guaranteed bandwidth for mission-critical operations is the quality-of-service commitment that shared public 5G cannot make.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a multi-omic data integration platform for precision oncology treatment selection.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform integrates genomic proteomic and metabolomic data from each tumour and matches it to clinical evidence - enabling oncologists to select the optimal treatment for each individual cancer.
quests.hint: Lead with the tumour-specific evidence matching.
quests.explanation: Evidence-matched tumour-specific treatment is the clinical case for precision oncology at its most compelling.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI clinical decision support tool reducing diagnostic errors in emergency medicine.
quests.correctAnswer: Our AI assists emergency physicians by surfacing diagnostic possibilities they might not consider - reducing missed diagnoses in time-critical decisions when cognitive fatigue is highest.
quests.hint: Lead with the cognitive fatigue vulnerability.
quests.explanation: Emergency physician cognitive fatigue creating diagnostic risk is a documented phenomenon - connecting to it creates clinical credibility.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a spatial biology platform mapping protein expression across tissue at cellular resolution.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform maps gene and protein expression within tissue at single-cell resolution - revealing the biological architecture of disease in detail that bulk sequencing completely obscures.
quests.hint: Lead with what bulk sequencing obscures.
quests.explanation: What existing methods miss - the spatial architecture - is the differentiation that spatial biology provides.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a consumer neurofeedback headset for evidence-based attention and focus training.
quests.correctAnswer: Our headset measures your specific brainwave patterns during focus and trains you to maintain them - evidence-based attention enhancement without any stimulant medication.
quests.hint: Lead with the stimulant medication alternative.
quests.explanation: Evidence-based neurofeedback as a stimulant alternative is a powerful positioning in a market seeking non-pharmacological solutions.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a non-invasive brain-computer interface for motor rehabilitation after paralysis.
quests.correctAnswer: Our non-invasive BCI decodes motor intentions from scalp signals and drives robotic limb assistance - enabling paralysed patients to engage in meaningful rehabilitation without surgery.
quests.hint: Lead with the surgery-free approach.
quests.explanation: Surgery-free BCI is the clinical access breakthrough that removes the implantation risk limiting broader use.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an implantable neural interface restoring speech in patients with ALS.
quests.correctAnswer: Our implantable BCI decodes intended speech directly from motor cortex activity - enabling ALS patients to communicate at conversational speed through a voice synthesiser.
quests.hint: Lead with conversational speed.
quests.explanation: Conversational speed rather than letter-by-letter spelling is the breakthrough that makes BCI speech restoration genuinely functional.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an impact-first venture fund delivering competitive returns from social and environmental investment.
quests.correctAnswer: Our fund delivers competitive financial returns from verified social and environmental impact investments - proving definitively that you do not have to choose between profit and purpose.
quests.hint: Lead with the false trade-off disproof.
quests.explanation: Disproving the profit-versus-purpose trade-off is the most powerful pitch to sceptical institutional investors.
